messages:
deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0 scheduled to prod in 2m. Canary cohort: 5% -> 25% over 30m. FF llm_rewrite_v2 will be enabled for canary at start. Change window: 2026-03-20 23:00-01:00 UTC. Pin: rwinfer/v2.14.0-quant.

alex: @deploy-bot quick ask — please pin model image to rwinfer/v2.14.0-quant@sha256:abc123 and set auto-fallback to v2.13.2 if p95 latency > 400ms or 5xx > 0.5%.

maya: watching infra metrics. Our SLOs for this path are p95 < 300ms and 5xx < 0.3%. If breached, hold ramp + alert.

qa-bot: Canary cohort (c-42) telemetry: at 10% after initial ramp. Error spike observed: 502 xfer_failed, ~0.8% errors over last 5m.

jen: seeing same in app logs. Snippet: ```kernel_selection: fallback to generic; mem_pressure=true; trace=oom-like``` Not a clean fail but latency and errors up.

sre-oncall: hold the ramp. @deploy-bot run: `/ff toggle llm_rewrite_v2 off --cohort=canary` and pin traffic back to v2.13.2. Need traces from the affected instances before we escalate.

deploy-bot: command received: toggling llm_rewrite_v2 -> off for cohort=canary. Action id=abcd-20260320. Rolling policy applied. Initiating rollback steps for impacted pods.

alex: Confirmed rollback. Running: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/serve model=rwinfer/v2.13.2` and clearing new kernel flags. Will watch for service churn.

product: noted — marking v2.14.0 as PAUSED in release tracker and adding regression flags to the release notes. We'll call out canary pause and follow-up tests.

maya: post-rollback metrics trending toward baseline within 4m of disable. Leaving ramp paused; recommend next attempt use micro-cohorts (1% -> 5% -> 10%) with extended soak and telemetry hooks.

jen: filing a follow-up runbook entry referencing kernel selection + quantization paths (PR #789). Assigning to @alex for root-cause investigation.

sre-oncall: please add a postmortem if unresolved within 48h. Closing this thread once stable. :white_check_mark:
